title: Oddly Oven Roasted Japanese San Marzano Tomato Onigiri
description: A mustardy and fluffy Japanese dish featuring San Marzano tomatoes, perfect for adventurous eaters, this diabetic-friendly onigiri is a unique twist on traditional Japanese cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the Japanese short grain rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the San Marzano tomatoes into small pieces and mix with kombu cold extract, Dijon mustard, rice vinegar, salt, sugar, and northern-style Japanese mustard.
Mix the tomato mixture with the prepared Japanese short grain rice.
Using wet hands, shape the rice mixture into triangular onigiri shapes.
Place the onigiri on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the onigiri in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the onigiri from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
